alerts.title: EFV-associated neuropsychiatric symptoms: insomnia and vivid dreams
alerts.message: Guidelines state EFV frequently causes neuropsychiatric effects, typically insomnia, vivid dreams and dizziness, mostly within the first 2-6 weeks of therapy. This patient has been on EFV since February 2024, nearly two years, and now reports several weeks of poor sleep and vivid dreams, which is atypical timing for early EFV toxicity and suggests another cause should be considered. Against drug attribution: onset is well after the typical early window. For attribution: the symptom pattern matches the EFV profile and it is part of the current regimen. Guidelines also advise screening for suicidality and mental symptoms; the patient denies suicidal ideation today.

evidence.recommended_action: Assess for other causes of insomnia and mental symptoms and screen for depression/anxiety with a validated tool (e.g., PHQ-9, GAD-7). Consider EFV-related neuropsychiatric effects and discuss regimen options with the clinician if symptoms persist or are distressing.
